description:
Done by fz-4t3.1 (ee78886b4 on develop, PR #314): the uniform calling tier is deleted from native_codegen, including the scalar Return tails in terminator.rs (the cont_ptr_known_null branch, emit_halt_and_return_null and the dynamic continuation-pointer check). The census this ticket asked for was a trap in every uniform arm run through the full gate: 4959 passed, 0 failed, no compiler trip. Generated code is identical over a 42-fixture sample.

What remains for fz-sc8.97: NativeBody.return_tuple_arity survives fz-4t3.1. In native_codegen its only reader is native_return_halt_repr (delivery.rs), the arm fz-sc8.97 replaces. If nothing else reads the field after .97, it leaves in that commit.
title: Delete the uniform-tier return paths in native_codegen/terminator.rs if no planned function reaches them
